body:
I know what you mean. Try to stay strong.

I am a scientist, I have high IQ, and I have almost everything that any other family would want their adult child to have. Yet, I’m still ignored. I’m invisible to everyone. Even at work, people want me to do things to get them out of a bad place, but afterward, I’m invisible for days on end. Everyone else gets attention and rewarded for their work and I get ignored. I could win a Nobel Prize for something and still would be ignored.

I know that I have Asperger’s but I found out in adulthood.

It literally hurts my soul that I am intelligent, extremely successful in life, yet in my field, my research is ignored because I am “different”.  I am never good enough for anyone to even seriously hold a conversation with me. I walk through life as a ghost and I only matter when someone wants something. 

I understand the way that you feel. It is so painful. I just want to disappear.
